## Why visit

A useful coastal-line stop for combining cask, a proper, unhurried sit-down meal and a traditional pub atmosphere. Different areas accommodate dining and drinking, and CAMRA describes a substantial handpump selection and a winter fire. It gives the Southport excursion a food anchor without requiring a city-centre detour. The pub’s past national competition recognition is secondary to the practical combination of beer range, community setting and easy rail access; choose it for a longer pause rather than a quick scorecard visit.
